newsitem.title: USA: Prodigy, NBA in internet marketing pact.
newsitem.headline: Prodigy, NBA in internet marketing pact.

text.p: Private Internet firm Prodigy Services Corp on Monday said it and the National Basketball Association (NBA) have entered into a marketing pact involving Internet content and Prodigy promotions.
Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed, but Prodigy did say it was a multiyear deal.
The NBA and Prodigy will build and, on April 24, launch, a co-branded area containing content available to Prodigy Internet subscribers.

Prodigy said it will also build an NBA merchandise shop, which will be hosted in the Prodigy Shopping Network and available to Prodigy Internet subscribers or anyone with a Web connection at http://www.shopnet.prodigy.com.
Prodigy Internet will be promoted during ESPN Radio Network's broadcast of NBA games and events through June.
ESPN Radio is a unit of ESPN Inc, which is majority owned by Capitol Cities/ABC Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Walt Disney Co. Hearst Corp owns a 20 percent stake in ESPN.
White Plains, New York-based Prodigy Services Corp is a wholly owned subsidiary of Medford, Mass.,-based Prodigy Inc.
